name: pivot_tunnel
description: Network pivoting: set up port forwards and SOCKS proxies using socat and SSH for lateral movement.
author: james-linux

params.command: echo '=== PIVOT SETUP ===' && echo 'Local IP:' && hostname -I && echo 'Target: {{target}}' && echo 'Internal net: {{internal_subnet}}'
echo '[+] Starting port forward: localhost:{{local_port}} -> {{target}}:{{remote_port}}' && socat TCP-LISTEN:{{local_port}},fork TCP:{{target}}:{{remote_port}} &

steps.description: Socat TCP port forward to internal target

params.command: echo '=== LATERAL MOVEMENT COMMANDS ===' && echo '' && echo '[SSH Dynamic SOCKS]' && echo '  ssh -D 1080 -N -f user@{{target}}' && echo '' && echo '[SSH Local Forward]' && echo '  ssh -L {{local_port}}:{{internal_target}}:{{remote_port}} user@{{target}}' && echo '' && echo '[Socat Reverse]' && echo '  socat TCP-LISTEN:{{local_port}},reuseaddr,fork TCP:{{target}}:{{remote_port}}' && echo '' && echo '[Netcat Relay]' && echo '  mkfifo /tmp/bp; nc -l {{local_port}} < /tmp/bp | nc {{target}} {{remote_port}} > /tmp/bp'
